scheme_name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Interest Subsidy
other_conditions: The subsidy is applicable only to new units or projects.
The term loan’s first disbursement date must fall within the scheme’s operative period (August 2 2021 to August 1 2026).
Developers must not be declared defaulters as per RBI guidelines.
Repayment against the principal must be timely.
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy on term loans for new logistics facilities, covering the moratorium period and calculated on the actual disbursed amount to encourage timely repayments.
